shared_elements: small animal figures grouped in loose horizontal rows
a vertical rectangular field carrying the imagery
justification: Both surfaces present schematic profile animals — birds and quadrupeds — distributed over a tall rectangular field, with some tendency to cluster in loose horizontal rows, which is the most specific correspondence. Otherwise they diverge sharply: A is deeply modelled, carved relief on weathered stone with figures locked into stacked registers, whereas B is a flat red-line graphic reproduction on a printed panel accompanied by blocks of text, with footprint-like marks and scattered, non-register placement.
